sql: select 'F' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side||'/'||f.action||' '||f.price||'x'||f.quantity||' fee '||f.fee d, f.filled_at::text ts from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > now()-interval '130 minutes' union all select 'O', market_ticker, side||'/'||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'')||' '||left(client_order_id,14), created_at::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (status in ('resting','open','pending','submitted') or (created_at > now()-interval '130 minutes' and coalesce(cancel_reason,'') not in ('resting_sell:repriced'))) union all select 'R', '', residual_cents::text, at::text from incentive_balance_observations where at > now()-interval '130 minutes' and residual_cents<>0 union all select 'P', market_ticker, coalesce(quantity_fp::text,quantity::text), captured_at::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from positions where (market_ticker like 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH%' or market_ticker like 'KXMAMDANI%') and captured_at > now()-interval '30 minutes' order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p where coalesce(quantity_fp,0)<>0 order by 1,4
